summary: A Yes vote extends and increases the city's half-cent sales tax to one cent with no expiration date, raising an estimated $46 million annually for city finances and deferred maintenance.

tax.text: Measure L would raise the existing sales-tax rate to one cent to maintain city services and prevent additional cuts.
tax.quote: If approved by voters, reauthorizes a previously voter-approved sales tax at an updated 1-cent rate for general City services to maintain Santa Rosa’s quality of life, the City’s financial stability, and the existing services community members identified as priorities.

tax.text: The No position opposes Measure L’s proposed 0.50-percentage-point sales-tax increase, which would raise Santa Rosa’s total sales-tax rate to 10.50%.
tax.quote: Measure L would increase the total sales tax rate in Santa Rosa by 0.50%, to 10.50%.
